method.time_origin: First stream SYN; all relative times seconds, sequence numbers relative to SYN ISN (first byte 1).
method.length: IPv4 total length minus IPv4 and TCP header lengths; never captured payload length.
method.records: Ethernet host capture contains coalesced records; record counts are not on-air segment counts.
method.ack_delay: Host inbound capture to outbound cumulative ACK capture; not network RTT and not ESP ACK reception.

workstation_wifi.source: Local iw dev wlp6s0 link and ip -brief address measurements

context.prior_controls: Earlier recorded WiFi-only fixture reproduced stalls without capture/encoding/web/MQTT; cache32/cache64 and periodic send retries did not establish a fix. See audit plan.

uncertainty: No sender-side or AP-side capture; no final tcpdump kernel-drop counters.
ACK-confirmed holes demonstrate receiver TCP lacked bytes at those instants, not where bytes were lost or whether later arrivals were retransmissions versus severe reordering.
Zero overlapping received payload does not mean zero sender retransmissions: original attempts can be absent from this capture.
Host-generated ACKs can be delayed or lost after the capture point; no proof they reached the ESP.
No-arrival intervals do not prove sender silence: unsent data, sender TCP gating, forward/return path delay or loss, AP bridging/queues and client driver/receive scheduling remain possible.
Cross-band clients use separate radio links; strong link rates/RSSI snapshots do not locate stalls or rule out either link or AP queues.
UART has device timestamps only; no exact clock synchronization to pcap.
Snaplen and receive coalescing prevent full FLAC validation and exact on-air segment/retransmission accounting.

next_experiment.name: Simultaneous AP-boundary and workstation capture of the existing WiFi-only fixture
next_experiment.design: Keep both existing radio links and fixture settings. Capture data and ACKs on the AP 2.4GHz-facing and 5GHz-facing interfaces plus workstation, with full TCP headers, documented capture hook positions, clocks aligned and final drop counters retained. Correlate by four-tuple and sequence/ACK ranges; no buffer/retry changes.
next_experiment.discrimination: Data present at AP from ESP but absent at workstation narrows failure downstream of AP ingress; ACK visible at workstation but absent at AP narrows the return client leg; ACK at AP but not confirmed delivered to ESP leaves AP-to-ESP/ESP receive path open. Missing data at AP still cannot distinguish ESP not sending from ESP-to-AP loss without sender/monitor evidence.
next_experiment.prerequisite: Requires AP access/capture support; Ethernet-down workstation alone cannot supply this boundary observation.
